# 目標是預測12月所以先創建12月資料
```{r}
# =========================
# A) Clean Weather Data
# =========================
df_weather <- read_csv("data/new_weather_2024.txt") %>%
  mutate(
    `觀測時間(hour)` = if_else(`觀測時間(hour)` == 24, 0, `觀測時間(hour)`),
    `降水量(mm)` = ifelse(`降水量(mm)` == "T", 0, `降水量(mm)`),
    `降水量(mm)` = as.numeric(`降水量(mm)`)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    station_pressure = `測站氣壓(hPa)`,
    temperature      = `氣溫(℃)`,
    humidity         = `相對溼度(%)`,
    wind_speed       = `風速(m/s)`,
    max_wind_speed   = `最大瞬間風(m/s)`,
    rainfall         = `降水量(mm)`,
    rain_duration    = `降水時數(h)`,
    solar_radiation  = `全天空日射量(MJ/㎡)`,
    uv_index         = 紫外線指數
  ) %>%
  select(-c(`最大瞬間風風向(360degree)`,
            `風向(360degree)`,
            `露點溫度(℃)`,
            `海平面氣壓(hPa)`,
            `總雲量(0~10)`,
            `能見度(km)`,
            `日照時數(h)`,
            `uv_index`,
            `rain_duration`))
```



```{r}
df_stat_info   <- read_csv("data/ntu_area_ubike_stations_sorted.csv")
df_stat_flow_m12<- read.csv("data/station_flow_202412_new.txt", sep = ",", header = TRUE)
df_is_weekday <- read_csv("data/weekday_or_not.csv")
```

```{r}

# =========================
# 2) (flow 與 info 同步)
# =========================

df_stat_info$sna <- gsub("^YouBike2\\.0_", "", df_stat_info$sna)

# =========================
# 3) 合併六個月份的 flow
# =========================
df_stat_flow_m12 <- df_stat_flow_m12


df_stat_flow_m12 <- df_stat_flow_m12 %>%
  left_join(df_stat_info, by = c("station" = "sna"))


# =========================
# 5) 簡單缺值處理與刪除不需要的欄位（站點靜態欄）
# =========================
df_stat_flow_m12 <- df_stat_flow_m12 %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>%
  select(-c(sarea, latitude, longitude, ar, sareaen, aren, act))
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 6) 新增三項時間特徵與淨借車量
# =========================

df_stat_flow_m12 <- df_stat_flow_m12 %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    hour = as.integer(hour),

    # 🚇 早晚尖峰
    is_peak_morning = hour %in% 7:9,     #上班尖峰
    is_peak_evening = hour %in% 17:19,   #下班尖峰
    is_peak_noon    = hour == 12,        #中午尖峰(短)
    is_peak_any     = is_peak_morning | is_peak_evening,

    # 🌙 深夜時段(低需求)
    is_night = hour %in% c(0:5, 23),

    # 🚲 淨借車量 = 借車 - 還車
    net_borrow = borrow_count - return_count
  ) 


```

```{r}

# 先把 date 都轉成 Date（用 ymd 可以吃到 2024/3/1 這種格式）
df_is_weekday <- df_is_weekday %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

df_weather <- df_weather %>%
  mutate(日期 = ymd(日期))

df_m12 <- df_stat_flow_m12 %>%

  # 6.1 合併 weekday / holiday 資訊
  left_join(df_is_weekday, by = "date") %>%   # 會多出 is_weekend, is_holiday

  # 6.2 合併天氣資料（已處理 24→0）
  left_join(
    df_weather,
    by = c("date" = "日期",
           "hour" = "觀測時間(hour)"))%>%
  mutate(
    is_dayoff = is_weekend | is_holiday)

df_m12 <- df_m12 %>% tidyr::drop_na()
readr::write_csv(df_m12, "df_m12.csv")


```


# 將3-5月9-11月資料餵進去訓練
# 看訓練模型對12月的解釋力
# 同時儲存模型
# 會跑非常久
```{r train_and_save_models}

# =========================================
# C) 分站訓練 + 預測 12 月 + 存模型
# =========================================

library(data.table)
library(ranger)
library(future.apply)
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores())

df_merged <- read.csv("df_merged.csv")
set.seed(42)

dt <- as.data.table(df_merged)
dt_m12 <- as.data.table(df_m12)

feature_cols <- c(
  "is_peak_morning","is_peak_evening","is_peak_noon","is_peak_any","is_night",
  "is_weekend","is_holiday","is_dayoff",
  "station_pressure","temperature","humidity","wind_speed",
  "max_wind_speed","rainfall","solar_radiation",
  "total"
)

targets <- c("borrow_count","return_count","net_borrow")
stations <- unique(dt$station)

# === 建立 models 目錄（如果不存在） ===
if (!dir.exists("models")) dir.create("models")

# === factor ===
for (nm in feature_cols) {
  if (is.character(dt[[nm]]))      dt[, (nm) := as.factor(get(nm))]
  if (is.character(dt_m12[[nm]])) dt_m12[, (nm) := as.factor(get(nm))]
}

out_dec_list <- list()

for (st in stations) {

  train <- dt[station == st]
  test  <- dt_m12[station == st]

  if (nrow(train) < 50 || nrow(test) < 3) next

  for (y in targets) {

    train_y <- train[, c(y, feature_cols), with = FALSE]
    test_y  <- test[,  c(y, feature_cols), with = FALSE]

    fml <- as.formula(paste(y, "~", paste(feature_cols, collapse = " + ")))

    # =====================
    # 訓練模型
    # =====================
    rf <- ranger(
      formula = fml,
      data = train_y,
      num.trees = 800,
      respect.unordered.factors = "order",
      seed = 888
    )

    # ===========================
    # 儲存模型 (一站 × 一 target)
    # ===========================
    model_path <- paste0("models/model_", st, "_", y, ".rds")
    saveRDS(rf, model_path)

    # =====================
    # 評估 12 月表現
    # =====================
    pred   <- predict(rf, test_y)$predictions
    y_true <- test_y[[y]]

    err <- y_true - pred

    SSE  <- sum(err^2)
    TSS  <- sum((y_true - mean(y_true))^2)
    R2   <- if (TSS > 0) 1 - SSE / TSS else NA
    RMSE <- sqrt(SSE / length(y_true))
    MAE  <- mean(abs(err))

    out_dec_list[[paste(st, y, sep=" :: ")]] <- data.table(
      station = st,
      target = y,
      R2_12m  = R2,
      RMSE_12m = RMSE,
      MAE_12m = MAE,
      test_n   = length(y_true),
      model_path = model_path
    )
  }
}

df_metrics_dec <- rbindlist(out_dec_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
print(df_metrics_dec)



```

```{r}


write_csv(df_metrics_dec, "R2_m12.csv")


```



# 建立補車策略計算用的資料df_m12_target
# 資料格式：
# |station|date|hour|borrow_real|return_real|borrow_pred|return_pred|net_borrow_pred|inventory|total|
```{r}


library(dplyr)

# 先複製一份
df_m12_target <- df_m12

# 只留下指定欄位，並排序成 sno, station, date, hour
df_m12_target <- df_m12_target %>%
  select(sno, station, date, hour, borrow_count, return_count, net_borrow, total)

# 新增預測欄位，預設為 0
df_m12_target <- df_m12_target %>%
  mutate(
    borrow_pred = 0,
    return_pred = 0, 
    net_borrow_pred = 0,
    inventory = total #inventory 預設為total
  )

# 再確保欄位順序完全是你要的
df_m12_target <- df_m12_target %>%
  select(sno, station, date, hour, borrow_count, return_count, net_borrow, borrow_pred, return_pred, net_borrow_pred, inventory, total)


```





# 餵12月的資料進去得到
# |borrow_pred|return_pred|net_borrow_pred|
# 共3個的欄位
```{r}

#讀取資料df_m12並且輸入進去model
#並更新在df_m12_target


# ======================================================
# D) 套用模型（分站預測）
# ======================================================

# feature cols 必須與訓練時一致（不含 target）
feature_cols <- c(
  "is_peak_morning","is_peak_evening","is_peak_noon","is_peak_any","is_night",
  "is_weekend","is_holiday","is_dayoff",
  "station_pressure","temperature","humidity","wind_speed",
  "max_wind_speed","rainfall","solar_radiation",
  "total"
)

# 將 df_m12 的欄位轉為 data.table，利於切 rows
dt_m12 <- as.data.table(df_m12)

# 逐站處理
stations <- unique(df_m12_target$station)

for (st in stations) {

  # 對應的行
  idx <- which(df_m12_target$station == st)
  if (length(idx) == 0) next

  # 模型路徑
  path_b <- paste0("models/model_", st, "_borrow_count.rds")

  path_r <- paste0("models/model_", st, "_return_count.rds")
  
  path_n <- paste0("models/model_", st, "_net_borrow.rds")

  if (!file.exists(path_b) || !file.exists(path_r)) next

  model_b <- readRDS(path_b)


  model_r <- readRDS(path_r)
  
  model_n <- readRDS(path_n)

  # 取出該站所有 rows 的(features)
  new_x <- dt_m12[idx, ..feature_cols]

  # 逐欄預測
  pred_b <- predict(model_b, new_x)$predictions
  pred_r <- predict(model_r, new_x)$predictions

  pred_n <- predict(model_n, new_x)$predictions
  # 更新回 df_m12_target
  df_m12_target$borrow_pred[idx] <- pred_b
  df_m12_target$return_pred[idx] <- pred_r
  df_m12_target$net_borrow_pred[idx] <- pred_n
}


# ======================================================
# E) 最終整理輸出欄位
# ======================================================
df_m12_target <- df_m12_target %>%
  select(sno, station, date, hour, borrow_count, return_count, net_borrow, borrow_pred, return_pred, net_borrow_pred, inventory, total)

print(head(df_m12_target))

write_csv(df_m12_target, "df_m12_target.csv")

```
